name: Chicago Weather, 6 July 2025
description: SCOUT's WRF-Chem weather run of 6 July 2025 over downtown Chicago, the weather its weather-aware routing reads: five files, 49 quarter-hour steps from 00:00 to 12:00 on a 1 km grid of 20 by 20 cells, each with the cells' XLAT and XLONG. RAIN.nc is rain, T2.nc the temperature at 2 m in kelvin, WSPD10.nc and WDIR10.nc the wind speed (m/s) and direction (degrees) at 10 m, and RH2.nc the relative humidity at 2 m (%). Read one with curio_load_data("data.scout.chicago-weather-2025-07-06", part="RAIN.nc").
license: Unspecified: SCOUT example data, source and license to be confirmed
sourceLabel: SCOUT weather-aware routing use case; WRF-Chem V4.5.1
